# googleads_sitelink_asset (Resource)

A sitelink asset — short clickable text under a search ad pointing to a deeper page. Asset content is immutable per the API; the wrapper's `name` can be renamed in place. **The API has no remove operation** — to stop managing this asset, unlink any campaign/ad_group attachments, remove from HCL, then `terraform state rm`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_sitelink_asset" "support" {
  customer_id  = "1234567890"
  name         = "Support sitelink"
  link_text    = "24/7 Support"
  description1 = "Chat with us anytime"
  description2 = "Response under 5 minutes"

  final_urls = ["https://example.com/support"]
}

resource "googleads_campaign_asset" "attach_support" {
  customer_id = "1234567890"
  campaign_id = googleads_campaign.search.id
  asset_id    = googleads_sitelink_asset.support.id
  field_type  = "SITELINK"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `final_urls` (List of String) Landing URLs the sitelink points to. Immutable.
- `link_text` (String) Display text (1–25 characters). Immutable.

### Optional

- `description1` (String) First description line (1–35 characters). If set, description2 must also be set. Immutable.
- `description2` (String) Second description line (1–35 characters). If set, description1 must also be set. Immutable.
- `name` (String) Optional display name. The API auto-generates one if omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Asset resource name (customers/{cid}/assets/{id}).
